import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

class TestVirtualClinic(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_create_consultation_request(self):
        # Arrange
        patient_id = 123
        symptoms = "Headache"
        reports = []
        mode = "Offline"

        # Act
        consultation_request = create_consultation_request(patient_id, symptoms, reports, mode)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(consultation_request.patient_id, patient_id)
        self.assertEqual(consultation_request.symptoms, symptoms)
        self.assertEqual(consultation_request.reports, reports)
        self.assertEqual(consultation_request.mode, mode)

    def test_create_appointment_request(self):
        # Arrange
        patient_id = 123
        symptoms = "Headache"
        reports = []
        mode = "Appointment"
        appointment_date = datetime.now() + timedelta(days=1)

        # Act
        consultation_request = create_consultation_request(patient_id, symptoms, reports, mode)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(consultation_request.patient_id, patient_id)
        self.assertEqual(consultation_request.symptoms, symptoms)
        self.assertEqual(consultation_request.reports, reports)
        self.assertEqual(consultation_request.mode, mode)
        self.assertEqual(consultation_request.appointment_date, appointment_date)

    def test_batch_program_create_appointment_file(self):
        # Arrange
        current_date = datetime.now()
        next_five_days = [current_date + timedelta(days=i) for i in range(1, 6)]

        # Act
        batch_program_create_appointment_file(next_five_days)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(appointment_files), 5)

    def test_batch_program_purge_existing_files(self):
        # Arrange
        appointment_files = [MagicMock() for _ in range(5)]

        # Act
        batch_program_purge_existing_files(appointment_files)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(appointment_files), 0)

    def test_predict_diseases_and_prioritize_requests(self):
        # Arrange
        consultation_requests = [MagicMock() for _ in range(5)]

        # Act
        predict_diseases_and_prioritize_requests(consultation_requests)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(prioritized_requests), 5)

    def test_doctors_view_prioritized_requests(self):
        # Arrange
        prioritized_requests = [MagicMock() for _ in range(5)]

        # Act
        doctors_view_prioritized_requests(prioritized_requests)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(viewed_requests), 5)

    def test_chemists_view_open_prescriptions(self):
        # Arrange
        prescriptions = [MagicMock() for _ in range(5)]

        # Act
        chemists_view_open_prescriptions(prescriptions)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(viewed_prescriptions), 5)

    def test_chemists_update_prescription_status(self):
        # Arrange
        prescriptions = [MagicMock() for _ in range(5)]

        # Act
        chemists_update_prescription_status(prescriptions)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(updated_prescriptions), 5)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
